description: Plan, two parallel builds (add, mul), a review and a join gate. Used by run_demo.py.

body.prompt: In this project, write PLAN.md listing exactly two functions to implement: add(a, b) in ops_add.py and mul(a, b) in ops_mul.py (return the sum and the product). Do not implement them.
body.verification: test -s PLAN.md && grep -q add PLAN.md && grep -q mul PLAN.md

branches.prompt: Follow PLAN.md. Implement add(a, b) in ops_add.py only; touch no other file. Run: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_calc.py -k add
Follow PLAN.md. Implement mul(a, b) in ops_mul.py only; touch no other file. Run: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_calc.py -k mul

body.prompt: Read ops_add.py, ops_mul.py and PLAN.md. Write REVIEW.md whose last line is exactly 'VERDICT: PASS' or 'VERDICT: FAIL'.
